game.title: Resident Evil Revelations
game.blurb: Survival horror game set aboard the cruise ship Queen Zenobia, from Capcom (RAWG also lists Capcom U.S.A and Tose), published by Capcom, released 2012-02-07. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters follow the campaign episodes and Raid Mode named in the Steam achievements.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry "resident-evil-revelations-biohazard-revelations" (id 4012); it lists platforms from Nintendo 3DS to PlayStation 4 and Switch under one entry, and RAWG's own store link points to Steam app 222480 ("Resident Evil Revelations"), the only matching app in the store list, so that app was used (its schema is named "ValveTestApp222480", a placeholder name). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Resident Evil: Revelations" at completion stage 1, but only Episode 1 (about 2,800 characters), Enemies (about 5,200), Controls (about 800) and Table of Contents are written; Episodes 2 to 12, Walkthrough, Handprints, Missions, Raid Mode, Weapons and upgrades, Characters, Gameplay and Achievements and trophies are linked but not written, so it was not used. Its contents list Episodes 1 to 12, matching the episode ranges in the achievements. residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil: Revelations" with about 140 linked articles (mostly cast and staff names); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden. Every description starts with a 【CAMPAIGN】 or 【RAID MODE】 tag, which the rules use. Pairing the episode ranges into two chapters is our own choice. "By the Crosshairs" (Rachael before the cafeteria), "A Packaged Deal" (Scarmiglione) and "Rockets are for Losers" (Malacoda) are boss or encounter feats that do not name an episode, so they sit in the campaign feats chapter.
